meta.title: ScheduleTimeSlotsView

fields.name: startTime
fields.mapping: static-config - 24h HH:mm, local to the user's timezone

fields.name: endTime
fields.mapping: static-config - 24h HH:mm, local to the user's timezone; always after startTime, schedules never span midnight in v1

meta.description: Static reference data (like ScheduleOptionsView) describing exactly when each schedule is active - one row per (scheduleId, dayOfWeek), so a schedule spanning several days has one row per day rather than a compressed range. This is deliberately explicit and machine-comparable (24h HH:mm, a fixed dayOfWeek enum) so a later automation can evaluate 'is now inside this project's schedule' to decide whether to trigger a notification immediately or hold it. A schedule with alwaysActive=true on ScheduleOptionsView (Any Time) has no rows here at all - absence of rows is not 'never active', check alwaysActive first. FUTURE: becomes event-sourced once custom schedules exist (see ScheduleOptionsView).
